objectives.teacher: Calculate the mean rate of reaction from the volume of gas produced over a measured time, using cm³/s.
Describe how to investigate the effect of hydrochloric acid concentration on its reaction with magnesium, measuring gas volume over time and controlling the mass of magnesium and temperature.
Explain why increasing hydrochloric acid concentration increases the rate of reaction with magnesium, using collision theory and the frequency of successful collisions.
